ops.quote: Finetuning a pretrained backbone in the encoder part of an image transformer network
incorporating semantic information into the encoder with the help of a semantic attention operation
provide supervision to the intermediate semantic prior maps at every stage
incorporating semantic priors enhances the performance of the established hierarchical encoders
use a lightweight semantic decoder during training to provide supervision
provide empirical proof by integrating SeMask into Swin Transformer and Mix Transformer backbones
our framework achieves a new state-of-the-art of 58.23% mIoU on the ADE20K dataset
improvements of over 3% in the mIoU metric on the Cityscapes dataset
